5523204.name: Chabad Learning Center of Northern Nevada
5523204.note: Anash.org, Aug 1 2022 ('Chabad Learning Center to Open in Reno, Nevada'): 'Rabbi Levi and Chana Sputz will be moving on Shlichus to Reno, Nevada to establish the Chabad Learning Center of Northern Nevada ... The Sputzs were appointed by head Shliach Rabbi Shlomo Cunin and regional director of Chabad of Northern Nevada Rabbi Mendel Cunin'. A report from the year itself (the listing number agrees).
